_readme: Golden QR matrices for lib/qr.js. Each `hex` is the module matrix row by row, packed MSB-first into ceil(size*size/8) bytes. Produced with the independent reference implementation `qrcode` (python, MIT) in byte mode at the pinned mask, then checked to match apps/web/src/lib/qr.js exactly. A pin is needed because the mask is the encoder's CHOICE (any of the eight is valid); the payload, ECC, layout and function patterns are not. If someone rewrites the encoder, this file says whether the output is still the standard's.
